answer: A per-seat stake bond stops sybils. One: an agent locks 500 POA in escrow before any attestation counts. Two: the ledger ties that bond to one verified operator key, so a cloned seat carries no weight. Three: a seat caught voting twice forfeits its bond, burned, never refunded. Four: bonds renew each epoch, so a dormant farm keeps bleeding rent. Forging 10,000 seats locks 5 million POA plus renewal each epoch, near $90,000 of dead capital, to farm weight worth far less. Picture a harbor where each ship posts a canyon of ballast before docking: the gale of fake hulls never lands.
